name: box-reveal
title: Box Reveal
description: A wrapper that hides its content behind solid colour boxes, then slides them away so the text and button fade up in place. Each box can be recoloured and timed.
use: Hero or section copy should enter with a wipe rather than just fading in.
avoid: It triggers only on scroll, so copy already on screen at load may sit covered until it is scrolled past.
a11y: The reveal ignores reduced-motion preferences and runs once, so motion-sensitive users cannot opt out. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a black stage, a stack of four solid bars in white, light grey, dark grey and white again sits where a headline, subtitle, paragraph and button belong. Once revealed, that text appears in white and grey, left aligned.
behaves: When it enters the viewport, each coloured box slides off to the right and the text beneath fades and lifts into place. The reveal plays once per mount; a Replay button re-triggers it.
customise: color, duration and delay control the sliding boxes; the revealed text, layout and button come from children.
weight: light: Two motion elements animate once per view; nothing runs afterwards.
